about: Cited-answer evaluation set (2026-10-07): Web-tab requests of every answer type, to measure how often a checked answer appears, whether its claims are right and backed by the passages shown, and whether it helps. Grades are human (evaluation/answer-labels.json); the verifier's own verdict is never the grade. kind: explanation, factual, comparison, current (freshness matters), niche (specialist or regional knowledge), skip (a resource search that must get no answer).
